Name: Kedi's NPC Utilities
Author: KeDili
Description:
[size=3][b]For users
[/b][/size][size=2]This is a modding tool for authors to use so just install this mod, along with SpaceCore if you don't have it already and drop both into your Mods folder.

[/size][b][size=3]For modders[/size]
[/b][size=2]This mod is a NPC Utility mod which's entries are CP-dependent. The mod is capable of having NPCs...:[/size]

[list]
[*][size=2]Be datable, but not marriagable (they will always deny the pendant, even if you're 10 hearts with them)[/size]
[*][size=2]Be marriagable(not roommate) but will never ask for children, even if you have none and have a crib.[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow you to gift custom items that's not a pendant or bouquet to propose marriage/date/breakup/divorce to another NPC.[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow NPCs to have events to [b]have them propose to the player [/b]for marriage/roommate/date/breakup/divorce[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow NPCs to either be always pregnant or always adopt children regardless of player's gender.[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow asymmetrical NPCs to have sided interaction(kiss or hug) frames (as in, one right-facing and one left-facing)[/size]
[*][size=2]Allow NPCs' any portrait frame to be shaked[/size]
[/list]
[size=2]Please refer to the example pack first for any formatting questions.[/size]

[b][size=3]Source Code:[/size][/b][size=2] [url=https://github.com/KediDili/NPCUtilities]Here [/url]it is! The mod uses Harmony.[/size]

[b][size=3]Known issues[/size][/b]
[size=2] - There might be issues with when you divorce NPCs, because vanilla handles it [i]really [/i]weirdly.
- ﻿Free Love is [b]NOT [/b]hard-incompatible, but it might block the sided interaction frame feature, or my mod ﻿might prevent its player&NPC kissing features[/size]
